projects.name: Project Titan
projects.objective: Build a real-time product recommendation and fraud-detection graph platform for GlobalRetail's German e-commerce operations.

projects.name: Project TitanX
projects.objective: Modernize RetailOne's legacy recommendation engine into a cloud-native microservices architecture on Amazon EKS.

projects.name: Project Atlas
projects.objective: Extend the GlobalRetail graph platform delivered under Project Titan to cover supply-chain traceability.

projects.name: Project Meridian Care Connect
projects.objective: Integrate Meridian Health Systems' regional hospital EHR platforms behind a unified interoperability layer.

projects.name: Project Fairview Data Modernization
projects.objective: Migrate Fairview's decision-support reporting off an on-premises Oracle 11g warehouse.

projects.name: Project Sterling Ledger
projects.objective: Replace Sterling Capital Bank's batch settlement process with an event-driven ledger on Kafka.

projects.name: Project Nordwest Core Banking
projects.objective: Deliver a phased core-banking replacement program for Nordwest Bank AG's retail division in Frankfurt.

projects.name: Project Harborview Claims AI
projects.objective: Automate first-notice-of-loss triage for Harborview using a generative-AI claims assistant.

projects.name: Project Continental OEE
projects.objective: Deploy real-time Overall Equipment Effectiveness monitoring across three Continental plants.

projects.name: Project Pinnacle Predictive Maintenance
projects.objective: Build failure-prediction models for Pinnacle's stamping-line equipment fleet.

projects.name: Project Orbit 5G Analytics
projects.objective: Stand up a network-quality analytics platform for Orbit Telecom's 5G core rollout in Singapore.

projects.name: Project Vantage Churn Insight
projects.objective: Deliver a churn-prediction model for Vantage Mobile Networks' postpaid subscriber base.

projects.name: Project Helios Grid Forecast
projects.objective: Forecast regional renewable load balancing for Helios Energy Partners' Dutch grid operator.

projects.name: Project Meridian Power Outage Analytics
projects.objective: Correlate outage-ticket data with grid telemetry to prioritize infrastructure repair for Meridian Power & Gas.

projects.name: Project SwiftPath Route Optimizer
projects.objective: Optimize last-mile delivery routing for SwiftPath Logistics' Southeast Asia fleet.

projects.name: Project Ontario Transit Modernization
projects.objective: Modernize fare-collection and scheduling systems for the Ontario Provincial Transit Authority.

projects.name: Project BrightWave Streaming Insights
projects.objective: Deliver real-time viewership analytics for BrightWave Media Group's streaming platform.

projects.name: Project Aventis Trial Data Hub
projects.objective: Centralize multi-site clinical trial data ingestion for Aventis BioPharma under GxP controls.

projects.name: Project Rhineland Pharmacovigilance
projects.objective: Automate adverse-event signal detection for Rhineland Pharma AG's European product lines.

projects.name: Project Falcon Connected Vehicle
projects.objective: Ingest and analyze telematics streams for Falcon Motor Works' new connected-vehicle fleet in the UAE.

projects.name: Project Retail Dynamics Personalization
projects.objective: Deploy a personalization engine for Retail Dynamics' UK loyalty program.

projects.name: Project Sterling Fraud Graph
projects.objective: Build a transaction-fraud graph-analytics capability for Sterling Capital Bank's card division.

projects.name: Project Harborview Legacy Migration
projects.objective: Originally scoped to migrate Harborview's policy-administration mainframe off IBM Cloud; cancelled after budget review.

projects.name: Project GlobalRetail Store Ops
projects.objective: Deliver an in-store operations dashboard for GlobalRetail ahead of the Titan graph platform engagement.

projects.name: Project Continental Vendor Portal
projects.objective: Build a supplier collaboration portal for Continental Manufacturing Co.'s procurement organization.

history_notes.note: Rolled off Project Titan in Q1 2025 and transitioned onto Project Atlas as the two engagements share the GlobalRetail graph-platform codebase.
